mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 PM, here is today's balanced dish: current conditions at the Verona Public Library are clear at 45 degrees. Under the first quarter moon, the International Space Station will be visible tonight starting at 6:34 PM, rising in the west northwest over Cross Plains and traveling toward the northeast near Madison, staying low near the horizon. We are expecting an overnight low of 33 degrees with no rain predicted.

The city has announced a public information meeting on December 8 at the Verona Senior Center to discuss the Military Ridge State Trail paving project, including bridge replacements and detours. Additionally, residents are reminded that curbside refuse and recycling are managed by Pellitteri Waste Systems, with specific guidelines for cart placement available on the city website.
While there are no events scheduled for the next 30 days, we look forward to the community meeting regarding the Military Ridge State Trail coming up on December 8.

In a notable service call from November 6, officers and fire personnel responded to a business on West Verona Avenue where they had to break into a vehicle to assist a driver who was later arrested for O W I.
Today's flavor of the day is Chocolate Volcano. Culver's is currently open and serving until 10 PM tonight, so there is still plenty of time to stop by for a scoop.
